qualification_limits: No independent human cryptographic review is established.
Isolated W CT does not qualify the whole F app, release compiler/architecture matrix, signer IPC, wallet encryption/derivation or general key generation as constant-time.
CT excludes rejection-count statistics, cache/speculation, physical power/EM, ARM/macOS/Windows execution, native assembly, erasure and production fitness.
Comparator agreement and test success are implementation evidence, not a cryptographic proof or production admission.
Public preflight is a completed 900-second test; it does not establish the separate 86400-second soak.
reference_policy: Original absolute build/runtime paths, artifact verifier public_selected_files paths, and original aggregator custody links are preserved historical observations. They are not dependencies of this portable selected-record packet. This new index uses only packet-relative paths for its selected evidence references.
